allow: PowerShell($files = @\("public\\home.html","public\\search.html","public\\detail.html"\); foreach \($f in $files\) { $p = Join-Path \(Get-Location\) $f; $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText\($p\); $t = [regex]::Replace\($t, 'price: \\d+, ', ''\); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText\($p, $t, \(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding\($false\)\)\) }; Select-String -Path $files -Pattern 'price' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Line)
